title: IGA-ODIL: Optimizing DIscretre robust Loss with Isogeometric Analysis to solve forward and inverse problems faster using machine learning tools
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) formulate the solution of partial differential equations as residual minimization problems over neural network parameterizations. Although highly flexible, optimization of PINNs using modern variants of Stochastic Gradient Descent algorithms is expensive. On the other hand, iterative computation of PINN parameterization using the Gauss-Newton method suffers from convergence difficulties, dense Jacobian structures, and poor conditioning that limit the effectiveness of second-order optimization methods.
